```lean
intro V inst v
have key : ∀ w : V,
    Quiver.StronglyConnectedComponent.mk w = Quiver.StronglyConnectedComponent.mk v ↔
      (Nonempty (Quiver.Path v w) ∧ Nonempty (Quiver.Path w v)) := by
  intro w
  constructor
  · intro hm
    have hr := Quotient.exact hm
    first
      | (obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hr
         exact ⟨by assumption, by assumption⟩)
      | exact ⟨hr.2, hr.1⟩
      | exact ⟨hr.1, hr.2⟩
  · intro hp
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hp
    first
      | (refine Quotient.sound ?_
         exact ⟨by assumption, by assumption⟩)
      | (refine Quotient.sound ?_
         constructor <;> assumption)
      | exact Quotient.sound ⟨h2, h1⟩
      | exact Quotient.sound ⟨h1, h2⟩
refine ⟨fun h w hne hp => hne (h w ((key w).2 hp)), fun h w hm => ?_⟩
by_contra hne
exact h w hne ((key w).1 hm)
```

```lean
intro α M X I hI hIX hX
have h : ∃ J, M.IsBasis' J X ∧ I ⊆ J := by
  first
  | exact hI.subset_isBasis'_of_subset hIX
  | exact hI.subset_basis'_of_subset hIX
  | exact hI.exists_isBasis'_superset hIX
obtain ⟨J, hJ, hIJ⟩ := h
have hJfin : J.Finite := by
  first
  | exact hX.finite_of_indep_subset hJ.indep hJ.subset
  | exact hX.finite_of_isBasis' hJ
  | exact hX.finite_of_basis' hJ
  | exact hJ.finite_of_isRkFinite hX
  | exact hJ.indep.finite_of_isRkFinite hX hJ.subset
exact ⟨J, hJ, hIJ, hJfin⟩
```

```lean
intro α n x
induction n with
| zero =>
  intro l₁ l₂ h
  first
    | simpa using h
    | exact List.cons_injective h
| succ n ih =>
  intro l₁ l₂ h
  cases l₁ with
  | nil =>
    cases l₂ with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons b t =>
      have h' : ([] : List α) = b :: t.insertIdx n x := h
      simp at h'
  | cons a s =>
    cases l₂ with
    | nil =>
      have h' : a :: s.insertIdx n x = ([] : List α) := h
      simp at h'
    | cons b t =>
      have h' : a :: s.insertIdx n x = b :: t.insertIdx n x := h
      injection h' with h1 h2
      rw [h1, ih h2]
```

intro C inst X A B f
constructor
· intro h
  haveI := h
  have h2 : CategoryTheory.IsIso
      ((CategoryTheory.Over.forget X).map ((CategoryTheory.MonoOver.forget X).map f)) :=
    inferInstance
  exact h2
· intro h
  haveI h1 : CategoryTheory.IsIso ((CategoryTheory.Over.forget X).map f.hom) := h
  haveI h2 : CategoryTheory.IsIso f.hom :=
    CategoryTheory.isIso_of_reflects_iso f.hom (CategoryTheory.Over.forget X)
  haveI h3 : CategoryTheory.IsIso ((CategoryTheory.MonoOver.forget X).map f) := h2
  exact CategoryTheory.isIso_of_reflects_iso f (CategoryTheory.MonoOver.forget X)

intro n m k hmk hnm
refine ⟨m / n, ?_⟩
rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
· simp [Nat.zero_dvd.mp hnm]
· have hnk : n ∣ k := hnm.trans hmk
  have h1 : n * (k / n) = k := Nat.mul_div_cancel' hnk
  have h2 : n * (k / m * (m / n)) = k := by
    rw [mul_comm (k / m) (m / n), ← mul_assoc, Nat.mul_div_cancel' hnm,
      mul_comm m (k / m), Nat.div_mul_cancel hmk]
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hn (h1.trans h2.symm)

have hnorm : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖Complex.exp z‖ = Real.exp z.re := fun z => by
  simp [Complex.norm_exp]
refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
· refine Filter.tendsto_iff_comap.1 (Filter.tendsto_atBot.2 fun b => ?_)
  have h1 : Complex.exp ⁻¹' Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (Real.exp b) ∈
      Filter.comap Complex.exp (nhds (0 : ℂ)) :=
    Filter.preimage_mem_comap (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 (Real.exp_pos b))
  rw [Filter.eventually_iff]
  refine Filter.mem_of_superset h1 fun z hz => ?_
  have h2 : z.re < b := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hnorm, Real.exp_lt_exp] using hz
  exact h2.le
· refine Filter.tendsto_iff_comap.1 ?_
  have h : Filter.Tendsto (Real.exp ∘ Complex.re)
      (Filter.comap Complex.re Filter.atBot) (nhds 0) :=
    Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp Filter.tendsto_comap
  refine tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.2 ?_
  simpa [Function.comp_def, hnorm] using h
